blocks.html: Pick the right symbol for what you are reporting, switch to mission-specific iconsets, and tune your own Self-Marker so the team can read you at a glance.

slides.title: Pick a marker subtype
slides.html: After choosing a marker, tap the subtype field to open Select Subtype, then pick the affiliation you need. Use Search to jump straight to a subtype instead of scrolling the list.

slides.title: Switch to a mission iconset
slides.html: Swipe the iconset area or tap the Iconset Name field to open the pallet list, then choose Mission for mission-specific symbols such as Contact Point (CP), Initial Point (IP) and Observation Point (OP).

slides.title: Customise your Self-Marker
slides.html: Set your marker size, main colour and outline under Settings > Display Preferences > My Location Color/Size. Use the Change/Create Icon Main Custom Color and Change/Create Icon Outline Custom Color sliders to make it stand out on the map.

slides.title: Place it with Fine Adjust
slides.html: Long-press Fine Adjust on the Self-Marker radial to open the sub-radial. Enter an exact MGRS Location or coordinate to drop yourself precisely instead of relying on GPS drift.
